**Critic Verification**: The codebase confirms the presence of a login wall using FirebaseAuth and GoogleSignIn in MainActivity.kt. However, Play Console administrative requirements cannot be verified from code alone. Downgraded to a suggestion. (Confidence: High)
findings.issue_summary: App displays or contains a login screen, registration wall, or authentication interface.
findings.recommendation:
Administrative Console Requirements: Because your app implements a login flow, you MUST complete two manual setup steps in the Play Console dashboard to pass review:
1. Reviewer Demo Credentials: Submit active, non-expiring test credentials so Google Play reviewers can access your gated features.
2. Account Deletion Link: Submit a public-facing web link for account deletion to satisfy Google Play's data deletion policies.

findings.evidence:
app/src/main/java/com/musically/studio/MyApplication.kt:30 unconditionally initializes CrashlyticsTree() in onCreate(), transferring performance diagnostics before the WelcomeScreen consent dialog can act as a gatekeeper.

**Critic Verification**: Verified. MyApplication.kt line 30 initializes Crashlytics unconditionally in onCreate(). This executes on app startup, completely bypassing the privacy consent gatekeeper in WelcomeScreen, confirming a silent background transfer violation. (Confidence: High)
findings.issue_summary: **Silent Background Transfer**: Policy violation. Data is sent without prior disclosure.
findings.recommendation: Delay the initialization of Crashlytics and other telemetry SDKs until after the user has explicitly accepted the Privacy Policy in the WelcomeScreen.
